text:
amanda: quick heads-up — when I open the console runs list with the 'team-alpha' saved search then add the quickfilter `status:failed`, I see a few rows that belong to org "acme" showing up. Not sure if UI or backend. Steps:
1) /console/runs -> select saved search 'team-alpha'
2) add quickfilter `status:failed`
Observed: rows with org_id: "acme". attaching screenshot.

ben: prod or staging?

amanda: prod. looked at the api trace — request headers include `x-workspace: team-alpha` but response payload contains rows with `org_id: acme`.

priya: this sounds like an auth filter got dropped in an aggregation/cache path. Did we change any prefetch/cache middleware recently? @marco

marco: i merged PR 4321 yesterday that moves route-context into the edge cache layer. the cache key currently omits workspace/org id — that would cause a cached page for one org to be served to another on a cache hit.

ben: ok — what's the lowest-blast fix? rollback 4321 on prod or patch to include workspace in cache key and invalidate?

amanda: low severity but real issue for affected customers. i'll start a rollback and open an incident note.

deploy-bot: rollback started for commit abcdef123 (PR 4321). rolling back service: console-api. ETA ~3m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marco: i'll follow up with a hotfix PR to add workspace/org to the cache key, add unit tests for cache key composition, and add an e2e that asserts two orgs' saved searches never return rows from the other org.

priya: also +1 on adding telemetry: emit `cache_key` + `workspace` tags to console cache hit/miss metrics so we can alert on cross-org hits.

amanda: thanks everyone. i'll monitor and post an update when rollback completes.
